testcase.name: the same holds for a waypoint, which is the rule the track follows
a withheld entry has the saved path but does not draw it
after the track is deleted the entry still keeps it as its snapshot, and draws its saved line
deleting an entry deletes its saved paths and no other entry's
the saved path is the read-seam-filtered path in timestamp order, not the stored rows
deleting the track again leaves the saved paths as they were
saving the entry again after the delete leaves its saved path in place and drawn
before the delete the entry has the kept track drawn and both counts at one
every entry that has the track gets a saved path, kept or withheld, committed or draft, and an entry with another track gets none
deleting the track leaves the entry's waypoint decision alone too
before the delete nothing is saved, the path is copied only when the track is deleted
the track's own points are still deleted, as the delete-data page says
